<!-- pr-reviewer: 54878770e24ff40dba1394bc94d31e8eca9d274c -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.** No blocking finding. This is the first review of this PR.

This is a SAFETY-tier review: the PR changes posted G-code (the program end of the Fanuc and Doosan DNM posts).

## What looks good

- The end blocks obey the order of the section return of #3466: `G49`, the Z retract, `G90`, the zero angle words with no X/Y/Z word, then the X/Y home.
- The X/Y home is `G91 G28 X0 Y0`. The via point is the current position, not work X0 Y0.
- `heldRotaries()` and `rotariesToZero()` are shared. The section return writes the same blocks as before (the 13 older tests of `upright_after_tilt` pass).
- An upright program ends byte for byte as before (`upright_program_end_adds_no_rotary_return`).
- The new tests are a submodule of the existing `upright_after_tilt` suite. There is no new test binary.
- The decision record `docs/decisions/3540-program-end-rotary-return.md` says what was chosen, why, and what was dropped. It names the other rotary posts.
- The body has `Changelog:`, "Goldens moved", "Not exercised" and `Fixes #3540`. The fixing commit ends with `Fixes #3540`.

## Results merged with main

Built and tested locally, in a worktree of the reviewer. The head `54878770e` was trial-merged with upstream/main `29bb9e9a2`. The merge is clean.

| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` | 145 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled |
| `post suites: upright_after_tilt` (in the quick gate) | 17 passed, the 4 `program_end::` pins included |
| `post suites: doosan_dnm_post`, `fanuc_post` | pass |
| `app suites: example_catalog`, `example_catalog_adaptive`, `example_catalog_edge_work` | pass |
| `app suites: conformance`, `program_units`, `posting` | pass |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |
| `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main` | 8 steps, 0 failed (release build, `do_not_touch`, `do_not_touch_adaptive`, `example_catalog`, `lathe_workholding_kinds`, `mcp`, `probe_no_coolant`, `sinker_burn`) |
| `cargo xtask gate light --base upstream/main` | 6 steps, 0 failed |

Extra suites run:

- Test data: the diff changes `examples/catalog/multiaxis/indexed/indexed.nc`. The suites that read `examples/catalog` and that the gates select are `example_catalog`, `example_catalog_adaptive` and `example_catalog_edge_work`. They pass in debug, and `example_catalog` passes in the heavy lane.
- Importers: the diff does not touch import code. The kernel suites were not necessary.

## Mutations (run by the reviewer, each restored after the run)

| Mutation | Result |
|---|---|
| M1: no `G49` in the Fanuc `uprightAtEnd()` | red: `fanuc: G49 cancels TCPM before the retract` |
| M2: `G28 X0 Y0` without `G91` in the Doosan `uprightAtEnd()` | red: `the X/Y home is incremental (no via point at work zero)` (2 pins) |
| M4: the Doosan `rotariesToZero()` call moved before the retract | red: `the tool retracts (G28) before the rotaries turn` (2 pins) |
| M3: the Fanuc `uprightAtEnd()` returns with no angle block after a trailing Go home | green: no test fails (see the follow-up) |

After the restore, the tree is clean and the suite is green.

## Golden, read line by line

`examples/catalog/multiaxis/indexed/indexed.nc` has one hunk, at the program end:

```
 M9
 M5
+G49
 G91 G28 Z0
-G28 X0 Y0
+G90
+G00 A0. B0.
+G91 G28 X0 Y0
 M30
```

- `G43.4 H01` (line 90) is active at the end of the last section. `G49` before the reference return is correct.
- `G90` precedes the angle block, so `A0. B0.` are absolute.
- The angle block has no X/Y/Z word.
- No other `*.nc` or `*.cl` file is in the diff.

## Program ends that the reviewer posted (a local probe test, not committed)

The body says that the Go-home path is not pinned. The reviewer posted it and read the output. Each end is correct.

| Post, options | Trailing ask | End blocks after `M5` |
|---|---|---|
| Fanuc, G28 | none | `G49` / `G91 G28 Z0` / `G90` / `G00 B0.` / `G91 G28 X0 Y0` / `M30` |
| Fanuc, G53 | none | `G49` / `G53 G00 Z0.` / `G00 B0.` / `M30` |
| Fanuc, G28 | Go home | `G49` / `G91 G28 Z0` / `G28 X0 Y0` / `G90` / `G00 B0.` / `M30` |
| Fanuc, G53 | Go home | `G49` / `G53 G00 Z0.` / `G00 B0.` / `M30` |
| Fanuc, G28 | Program stop | `M0` / `G49` / `G91 G28 Z0` / `G90` / `G00 B0.` / `G91 G28 X0 Y0` / `M30` |
| Doosan, G28, A turns | none | `G49` / `G91 G28 Z0` / `G90` / `M11` / `G00 A0.` / `M10` / `G91 G28 X0 Y0` / `M30` |
| Doosan, G28, A turns | Go home | `G49` / `G91 G28 Z0` / `G28 X0 Y0` / `G90` / `M11` / `G00 A0.` / `M10` / `M30` |
| Doosan, G53, A turns | Go home | `G49` / `G53 G00 Z0.` / `M11` / `G00 A0.` / `M10` / `M30` |

A Doosan program with no declared brake codes keeps its refusal (`rotary clamp/unclamp codes not declared`), so the post gate blocks it as before.

## Requested before merge

None.

## Follow-ups (file after merge)

1. **P7, `area:post`, `effort:high` (safety floor): pin the Go-home program end.** `assets/posts/fanuc.cps:790-795` and `assets/posts/doosan-dnm.cps:848-853` have a `homed` branch that no test reads. Mutation M3 (the branch writes no angle block) passes all suites. Add one test to `crates/post/tests/upright_after_tilt/program_end.rs`: a tilted last section with `PARAM AfterOperation home`, for the two posts, in G28 mode and G53 mode. Assert that the zero angle block comes after the home blocks and before `M30`, and that there is no second `G49` and no second retract. The output today is correct (table above), so this does not block the merge.

## Optional, non-blocking

- `assets/posts/doosan-dnm.cps:1497-1504`: `onClose()` writes the chip conveyor stop before the home check. When a conveyor stop is written after a trailing Go home, `homedAt` does not match and the full end sequence is written again. This order is older than this PR, and the result is safe (one more retract).
- The Fanuc setup-change stop (`afterOp()`, `fanuc.cps:851-857`) retracts with no `G49` under G43.4. The Doosan post writes `G49` there. This code is not in the diff.

## Law check

- Prime Directive: no new refusal is hidden. The `safeRetract` G53 refusal and the brake-code refusal stay counted warnings.
- Clean-room: the new test file has a provenance line (RS-274, FANUC G49). No vendor material.
- Code shape: the post scripts are exempt from the 400-line rule. The test files are below 400 lines.
- No UI change, no process file, no dependency, no snapshot PNG, no `CHANGELOG.md` edit.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Merging as SAME (no head movement since the counted review). The review that stands: `<!-- pr-reviewer: 54878770e24ff40dba1394bc94d31e8eca9d274c -->` by mkinney, clean at head `54878770e24ff40dba1394bc94d31e8eca9d274c`. Merge commit pinned with `--match-head-commit`.
